notesForTheArchitect: The eighth shape caught my own instrument this round, one round after I named it. My round-eleven rig drove nine causes and Disappeared was not among them: I enumerated from the gate's text and from the types I had already met, so the rig could not fail for the case the gate got wrong. The fix is the one I sent you as the shape's operational form, applied to the case list rather than to the code - enumerate from the source that defines the set, not from the set you remember - and this round's eleven cases come from a grep over ghautomerge for every declared error type and every Is(target) == wait.ErrWaiting. Worth recording as the shape's second instance in this tree, with the tester's rig as the thing that carried it.

The allow-list is better than a corrected deny-list for a reason that outlives this bug and belongs in the learning: a deny-list over an open set is wrong by default when the set grows, an allow-list is silent by default. The reviewer asked for the right shape and not only the right answer.

The rig's limit is unchanged and still stated wherever it is cited: it proves which way the gate decides, never that the payload and the notice commit in one transaction under the row's lease, which stays CI's.
Fast-follow unchanged across twelve rounds and still on the body's line: folding rememberWait's positional arm bool, and renaming readyChecks, which reads no check.
